name: Prayagraj Municipal Corporation
headquarters: 1, Sarojini Naidu Marg, Civil Lines, Prayagraj 211001
description: Prayagraj Nagar Nigam governs the municipal area of the city formerly named Allahabad. The corporation lists 100 numbered wards. Prayagraj district includes other urban bodies; the Prayagraj Mela Authority is separate from the corporation.
